text: dsh-pgragh（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框上方展示并行工具执行时间线，查看同一步调用的开始、完成和提交状态。它观察工具执行及会话事件，并通过实时事件流更新界面。时间线区分运行中、等待提交和已提交，也标记 subagent、code-mode 与 exclusive barrier；悬停可查看工具标签、耗时和提交等待。插件还计算并行度、串行估算、节省时间和峰值并发，适合想了解 DSH Web 多工具执行过程的用户。需要 DeepSeek Harness Web 和 Node.js。

dsh-pgragh adds a live tool timeline above the DSH Web composer. It shows running, waiting-to-commit, and committed calls, with markers for subagents, code-mode, and exclusive barriers. Hover for labels and timings. It displays parallelism and estimated time saved. Requires DSH Web and Node.js.
想在 DSH Web 里看同一步的多个工具什么时候并行运行、什么时候完成。
工具已经跑完但结果还没提交时，有没有办法在界面上看出来？
I want to see how much time parallel tool calls save in a DSH conversation.
dsh-pgragh 的功能「实时调用时间线」：在 DSH Web 输入框上方显示当前步骤的工具调用。点位表示完成时间，状态区分运行中、等待提交和已提交；悬停可查看标签、耗时与等待时间。
dsh-pgragh 的功能「并行耗时指标」：根据叶子工具调用的开始和完成时间计算并行度、串行耗时估算、节省时间及峰值并发，并在时间线旁展示并行度和节省时间。

dsh-pgragh README · Introduction：dsh-pgragh adds one compact white line above the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) composer. Every point comes from a real tool dispatch, physical completion, and ordered session commit, so you can see whether parallel work happened, where it waited, and how much wall time it saved.

```text
model emits:    A  B  C  D
completion:     B  A  C  D
ordered commit: A  B  C  D
```

dsh-pgragh README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness and Node.js `22.19+` or `24+`.

```bash
npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pgragh@0.1.0
npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

Open a conversation and run more than one tool in a step. The line appears automatically and stays hidden when there are no calls. A source install is also supported:

```bash
npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:dangoZhang/dsh-pgragh
```

dsh-pgragh README · Read the line：- **Position and state:** point position is physical completion time; a hollow pulse is running, a double outline is completed but waiting for ordered commit, and a solid point is committed. Hover for the tool label, duration, and commit wait.
- **Call type:** an outer ring marks a subagent, a small point marks a code-mode internal call, and a diamond marks an exclusive barrier. `T17 · S4` identifies the active turn and step.
- **Savings:** `Parallelism = serial leaf-work estimate / wall time`; `Saved = serial estimate - wall time`. Parent `run_code` calls are excluded when their internal calls are visible, preventing double counting.

dsh-pgragh README · Ground truth and limits：The host observes the official `tools/execute` around-dispatch path for start and completion timestamps. Persisted `tool/result` and `tool/code-dispatch` session events determine when results become model-visible. The observer is read-only: it does not change arguments, results, scheduler behavior, or commit order.

dsh-pgragh README · Ground truth and limits：The SSE feed contains only session id, tool name, optional description, status, and timestamps. The UI shows the latest observed step; its in-memory timeline starts again when the DSH host restarts.

dsh-pgragh README · Verification：`pnpm check` runs strict type checking, both host and browser builds, state-machine and metrics tests, plus a real DSH integration test using the official `ToolRuntime`, `SessionStore`, and `WebServer`.

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm check
```

Focused issues and pull requests are welcome. Keep the observer read-only and include behavioral tests for timeline changes.

dsh-pgragh README · Introduction：dsh-pgragh 在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 输入框上方加入一条简洁的白色执行线。每个点都来自真实的工具 dispatch、物理完成和有序 session commit，让你直接看见并行是否发生、结果在哪里等待，以及实际节省了多少 wall time。

```text
模型发出： A  B  C  D
物理完成： B  A  C  D
有序提交： A  B  C  D
```

dsh-pgragh README · 安装：需要 DeepSeek Harness，以及 Node.js `22.19+` 或 `24+`。

```bash
npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pgragh@0.1.0
npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

打开会话并在同一步运行多个工具。存在调用时执行线自动出现，没有调用时自动隐藏。也可以直接从源码安装：

```bash
npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:dangoZhang/dsh-pgragh
```

dsh-pgragh README · 怎么读：- **位置与状态：** 点的位置对应物理完成时间；呼吸空心点正在运行，双轮廓点已完成但仍在等待 ordered commit，实心点已经提交。悬停可查看工具标签、执行耗时和 commit wait。
- **调用类型：** 外环表示 subagent，小点表示 code-mode internal call，菱形表示 exclusive barrier；`T17 · S4` 标记当前 Turn 和 Step。
- **节省时间：** `Parallelism = 叶子工作串行估算 / wall time`，`Saved = 串行估算 - wall time`。内部调用可见时不重复计算外层 `run_code`。

dsh-pgragh README · 数据依据与限制：Host 在官方 `tools/execute` around-dispatch 路径记录开始与完成时间；持久化的 `tool/result` 和 `tool/code-dispatch` session 事件决定结果何时对模型可见。观察器只读，不改变参数、结果、scheduler 行为或 commit 顺序。

SSE 只发送 session id、工具名、可选描述、状态和时间戳。界面展示最近一次观测到的 Step；DSH Host 重启后，内存中的时间线会重新开始。

dsh-pgragh README · 验证：`pnpm check` 会运行严格类型检查、Host 与浏览器构建、状态机和指标测试，以及使用官方 `ToolRuntime`、`SessionStore`、`WebServer` 的真实 DSH 集成测试。

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm check
```

欢迎提交聚焦的问题和 Pull Request。观察器必须保持只读，时间线行为变更需要对应测试。
